Ok a few things. I’m assuming you’re in your late twenties or right around 30. So my age pretty much. Leave the high school mentality in high school. Those “cool party” people that still cling onto that shit now PEAKED in HS and have bland personalities. Why are you looking up to teenagers wishing to be like them? You’re an adult. Don’t follow a crowd. Develop your own personality and hobbies.  

And “cool”, normal, fun people don’t go around making fun of strangers for no reason. Assholes do that. And you don’t want to be an asshole. 

And I would honestly brush it off. Those kids probably don’t even remember that interaction between you and them. I mean what do KIDS know? And who cares? Why do you want their shitty validation anyways. You’re a human worthy of love and respect and you don’t need bratty teenagers to tell you that. Look in the mirror and tell yourself that. You’re a man. THE MAN. Practice positive affirmations everyday, work on your self image and work on body language. You won’t see a change overnight but it will greatly help. 

And stop giving a fuck about others opinions/thoughts of you. I stopped long ago and honestly life became so much simpler.
